_why: THE CONTRACT THIS REPO IS WRITTEN AGAINST. `pnpm sync-types` generates the API types from the aidream CHECKOUT, offline, so a deploy lag can never silently delete a field the client uses. When someone deliberately generates from a SERVER instead (`pnpm sync-types:live`), this pin is the floor: the server's git_sha (GET /health/version) must contain this commit, or the sync refuses and says the server is behind. Raise `minimum_aidream_sha` whenever this repo starts using a newly added server field.
reason: Legal and Print surface launchers require the canonical legal/print attribution values added in aidream 62fa56114. This descendant also retains the directive idempotency and ledger-backed receipt contracts previously pinned at d57c25e0c.
